sessiond-hooks

sessiond-hooks launches and supervises a per-user session hook for every unique UID observed by sessiond. It can be used to start a per-user service manager such as dinit --user or runsvdir.

Configuration

[on_start]
exec = "/usr/bin/dinit"
args = ["--user", "--services-dir", "~/.config/dinit.d"]

[restart]
on = "Failure"
delay = 5
